title: Meta is losing its longtime head of infrastructure | TechCrunch
summary: It sounds like Janardhan will remain at Meta for a little bit, although he is expected to leave next year. “Santosh will stay on for transition and he is moving into an advisory role on Meta Compute,” said a Meta representative.
